# Codex Finish Prompt

Use this at the end of a DesktopCatPet development pass:

```text
Please finish this DesktopCatPet version:
1. inspect changed files
2. update README, CHANGELOG, ROADMAP, PRD, TEST_PLAN, DECISIONS, and release notes when relevant
3. run scripts/project_finalize.sh
4. commit the source changes
5. tag the version if stable
6. push to GitHub if origin is configured
7. summarize release assets and remaining risks
```
